data.current_summary: Create timer criteria (Pomodoro style) for a task
data.description_suggestion: Adds a Pomodoro-style timer success criterion to a habit task. Accepts a TimerCriteria object specifying duration (in minutes), number of cycles, and break intervals. The task will then require completing the specified timer cycles to be marked as successful. Returns the created TimerCriteria object linked to the task. Requires bearer token authentication and task ownership. A task can have only one active timer criterion at a time; creating a new one replaces the previous criterion.
